name: Wuk Lamat
text:
If you control 7 or more Characters, Wuk Lamat gains "If a Forward you control deals damage to a Forward, the damage increases by 2000 instead."
When Wuk Lamat enters the field or attacks, choose 1 Forward opponent controls. If you control 5 or more Characters, deal it 7000 damage.

name: Zack
text:
If your opponent controls 3 or more Forwards, Zack gains Haste.
When Zack enters the field or attacks, deal 1000 damage for each Backup you control to all the Forwards opponent control.

name: Charlotte
text:
If Charlotte is dealt damage, reduce the damage by 1000 instead.
The Forwards you control cannot be chosen by your opponent's Summons of cost 1.
The Forwards opponent controls cannot use action abilities.

name: Yuna
text:
When Yuna enters the field, you may play 1 Forward of cost 3 from your hand onto the field.
When Yuna attacks, look at the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card among them to your hand and return the other cards to the bottom of your deck in any order.
